summary.headline: Judgment of Betrothal
summary.text: Astrological judgment of betrothal and marriage from the seventh sign and its lord, planets in the seventh house, Venus, the Moon, and the lot of betrothal. Venus’s house position, condition, triplicity lords, and aspects indicate early or late betrothal, fortune with women, and difficulties arising from marriage.
